recipe.visualDefinition: A tactile, DIY-style collage featuring a central photograph of two people with an acoustic guitar, pinned and taped onto a dark denim fabric background with handwritten labels on scraps of paper and tape.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photo anchored by a red pushpin and paperclip
Rough-edged duct tape at the bottom serving as a primary text container
Layered paper scrap at the top for secondary metadata
High-contrast relationship between dark denim and bright white paper elements
coreInvariants: Hand-drawn felt-tip marker aesthetic for all text
Physical office supplies (red pin, red paperclip) as decorative anchors
Slightly rotated central image to suggest manual placement

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-shot portrait of two people occupies the central 70% of the frame, slightly tilted counter-clockwise.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large strip of silver/grey duct tape at the bottom center acts as the primary visual weight for the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red pin top-left, moves across the top label, down through the central portrait, and settles on the large tape label at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark denim texture provides a dense, textured negative space around the central collage elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy tones in the photograph contrasted against high-value white labels and high-saturation red accents.

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness mimicking a felt-tip marker
Inconsistent baseline and x-height to emphasize the 'handmade' feel
Disconnected characters with occasional natural ligatures
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'F' with a long, slightly curved top bar
Lowercase 'x' drawn with two distinct, crossing strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights of the same handwriting style to create a cohesive 'journal' look.
graphicDevices: Duct tape texture with horizontal ridges
Plastic red pushpin with drop shadow

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, bold stroke of the main title.
Good for the smaller, neater handwriting on the top scrap.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark indigo denim fabric background. Place a central photograph of a smiling man and woman with an acoustic guitar, slightly tilted. Add a red pushpin in the top left corner and a red paperclip. Place a torn piece of white notebook paper at the top and a wide strip of silver duct tape at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add handwritten text in black marker style. The main title should be large and centered on the duct tape. A secondary title should be smaller and placed on the torn paper scrap at the top.

verificationChecks: Is the denim texture visible and realistic?
Does the duct tape have visible ridges and torn ends?
Is the handwriting style consistent with a felt-tip marker?
Are the red accents (pin/clip) providing a pop of color?

adjustableVariables: Color of the pushpin and paperclip
Width of the duct tape strip
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the clothing
Identifiable faces if not using stock imagery
Specific text content from the original

mustAchieve: Convincing shadows under the pin and paper scraps

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the 'handwritten' style
Check that the photo tilt looks intentional, not accidental
Verify the red accents don't overwhelm the composition
Confirm the duct tape texture looks metallic/plastic and not just grey paper
recipe.reuseFormula: Layer a [Subject Photo] onto [Textured Fabric Background] using [Office Supplies/Tape] as anchors, then overlay [Handwritten Marker Text] on [Paper/Tape Scraps] for a DIY scrapbook aesthetic.
